 This individual will work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, technical resources, and project leadership to gather requirements, improve financial processes, troubleshoot system issues, and ensure SAP solutions align with business objectives.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Configure, maintain, and support SAP FICO modules to meet business and financial reporting requirements.
* Provide functional support for SAP FICA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable), including troubleshooting, configuration, and process improvements.
* Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, IT, and other business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Participate in SAP implementation projects, including requirements gathering, system design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Support SAP S/4HANA Finance functionality and assist with system enhancements, upgrades, and optimization initiatives.

* Develop functional specifications and work with technical teams to support system enhancements, integrations, and custom development.
* Coordinate and execute system testing, including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Support data migration, validation, and reconciliation activities during SAP implementations and system changes.
* Create and maintain functional documentation, process flows, configuration records, and end\-user training materials.
* Provide ongoing production support and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure system stability and continuous improvement.



  





 Required Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of hands\-on SAP FICO configuration and support experience** 
 , including financial accounting and controlling processes.
* **1–2 years of experience with SAP FICA** 
 , including functional support and configuration.
* **At least 1 full lifecycle SAP implementation**

* Working knowledge of

 , including both FICO and FICA functionality.

* Ability to troubleshoot configuration issues, analyze system functionality, and support financial process improvements.
* Experience supporting system testing, documentation, and end\-user training.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with functional, technical, and business teams in an enterprise environment.



  





 Work Arrangement
 


* Hybrid position based out of

 .
* Local candidates should expect to work onsite approximately
 **2 days per week** 
 .

 .

jobs.title: SAP BRIM TECHNICAL CONSULTANT
jobs.description:
SAP BRIM Technical Consultant
   

  

 Summary
   

 We are seeking a highly skilled SAP BRIM Technical Consultant to join our IT Services team. In this pivotal role, you will leverage your expertise in SAP Business Relationship and Revenue Management to drive technical implementation and integration efforts. The position demands a professional capable of bridging complex business requirements with robust technical solutions, ensuring seamless data flow and system performance across the enterprise landscape. This role is essential for optimizing revenue management processes and supporting critical business operations within our dynamic technology environment.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

* Design and develop technical integrations between SAP HANA and S/4HANA environments to ensure data consistency and operational efficiency.
* Engineer and maintain custom forms using both SmartForms and Adobe Forms solutions to meet specific reporting and document generation needs.
* Utilize Eclipse ADT and SAP GUI for effective development, debugging, and maintenance of application components.
* Contribute to the modernization of user interfaces by implementing SAP BTP Fiori and UI5 applications where applicable.
* Develop and enhance core business logic using SAP ABAP and Object\-Oriented ABAP methodologies.
* Implement system extensions and modifications through the Enhancement Framework, including the creation of BAdIs and User Exits.
* Configure and support key SAP BRIM modules, specifically Sales Order Management (SOM), Convergent Charging (CC), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and FI\-CA, to facilitate accurate billing and revenue recognition.


 Requirements
   

  

**Requirements:**
* Possess a minimum of 3 years and a maximum of 6 years of professional work experience in SAP technical roles.
* Demonstrate proven proficiency in SAP HANA and S/4HANA integration patterns.
* Show strong command over form development tools, specifically SmartForms and Adobe Forms.
* Be well\-versed in development environments such as Eclipse ADT and SAP GUI.
* Exhibit a solid understanding of SAP ABAP and Object\-Oriented ABAP programming principles.
* Have hands\-on experience with the Enhancement Framework, including BAdIs and User Exits.
* Display specialized knowledge of the SAP BRIM suite, with a focus on SOM, Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, and FI\-CA.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP, Fiori, and UI5 is considered a valuable asset.
